## County checklist

- [ ] One county file only: `research/county/<ST>/<FIPS>-<name>.md`
- [ ] Public sources only: every link opens without an account or a paywall
- [ ] Every number in `claims` has an exact `quote` copied from its source
- [ ] Contacts are official office lines, emails and addresses published on the cited page
- [ ] No personal cell numbers, home addresses or personal social media accounts
- [ ] No individual experiencing homelessness is named or pictured, in the text or in a quote
- [ ] `python3 scripts/county.py check <FIPS>` passes; its output is pasted below
